description: Read a remote MCP server or SKILL.md review before installing. MCP: server, domain, tools and measured signals. Skill: static findings with file, line, excerpt and context; no command execution or referenced-script review. Unread skills stay unchecked. Read the limits in aviso. Take the id from list_listings. We visit remote MCP servers: `initialize` and `tools/list`, without credentials or tool calls, again 7 days after a success. A failure needs a second check. MCP signals: dns_morto, sem_https, tls_invalido, tunel, nao_responde, nao_mcp, texto_suspeito, redireciona_fora, repo_arquivado, repo_parado, dominio_recente, login, bloqueado. For skills, `tipo: skill` identifies a static SKILL.md review. It flags secret reads, download-and-execute commands, external uploads, invisible characters, long encoded text and broad allowed-tools. `revisao.achados` supplies the path, original line, excerpt and context. Examples and prohibitions do not raise the level. Excerpts hide sensitive values. The review does not run commands or follow references. Supported source: public raw.githubusercontent.com SKILL.md. Watched, visited, starred and new skills get priority within the shared GitHub governor and a daily cap. Unread or unsupported skills remain explicitly unchecked. Local MCP servers and plugins answer `nao_remoto`. No request fetches a third-party source. Cached for 5 minutes.

api_pass.description: MAT-only private pass: mat_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Generate and save before buying.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.
